meta.title: BSP professional network graph (public roles only)
meta.author: Syed Rahman
meta.method: Nodes and edges built from broadskypartners.com (team, bios, strategy, deal pages), deal press releases (Business Wire via FinancialContent mirrors, PR Newswire, CPA Practice Advisor, Pulse 2.0, MR Magazine), company newsrooms, SEC filings (Form D, Form ADV, BDC 10-Q/N-PORT/N-CSR schedules of investments), UK Companies House accounts and charges, USPTO assignment records, and franchise trade press (ACHR News, Apax, IFA, CleanFax, Citybiz). Existing repo datasets (BSP firm profile, filings datasets, add-on target lists) were reused with their original source URLs and retrieval dates; new facts were fetched 2026-10-06. Edges carry one-sentence evidence and the source that supports it. Intro paths are analyst constructions over sourced nodes and edges; confidence reflects proximity (same franchise system or same seller-banker = high/medium; geography-only = low).

schema.node: {id, kind:'node', type, name, org, title, sector_tags[], relevance_to_pipeline, source_url, retrieved}
schema.edge: {id, kind:'edge', from, to, relation, evidence, date, source_url, retrieved, current?}

node_types_extended.portfolio_company: portfolio companies and named add-ons, needed as edge endpoints
node_types_extended.counterparty_sponsor: other sponsors on BSP deals (BV, Svoboda, TPG Growth, Apax)

relations_extended.invested_in: sponsor or buyer equity investment in a company
relations_extended.acquired: portfolio company acquired an add-on / franchisor acquired brands

schema.notes: works at with current=false marks a prior or outside role. advised deal for BSP people marks their deal-team role. portfolio CEO is used for portfolio-company leaders, including add-on owners who joined the company.

intro_paths.target: Ron Williams group: Benjamin Franklin / One Hour / Mister Sparky of West Chester, PA (fit 82)
intro_paths.path: Same franchise system: Matt Buckwalter (Punctual Pros) -> Authority Brands trade-brands leadership (Steve Clemente / Mark Dawson) -> tri-brand franchisee. Authority Brands must approve territory transfers, so the franchisor is both the intro path and a required consent.

intro_paths.target: PHE, Inc. d/b/a The Punctual Pros NJ (South Jersey tri-brand franchisee, fit 80)
intro_paths.path: Peer franchisee path: Frank Horvath (NJ tri-brand operator, now inside Punctual Pros) and Matt Buckwalter -> Authority Brands franchisee community -> South Jersey operator. Shared brand set and NJ footprint make this the warmest path.

intro_paths.target: Calvert's: One Hour / Benjamin Franklin of Wilmington & Dover, DE (fit 74)
intro_paths.path: Same One Hour / Benjamin Franklin brands -> Authority Brands service-trades leadership -> Delaware franchisee.

intro_paths.target: Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical (independent, East Petersburg PA, fit 84)
intro_paths.path: Independent (no franchise tie): best public path is the sell-side team that ran the Punctual Pros sale (Boxwood Partners, Barley Snyder, Trout CPA), which already advises Central PA home-services owners, plus Matt Buckwalter's local reputation.

intro_paths.target: C&C Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing & Electric (Belford, Monmouth Co. NJ, fit 82)
intro_paths.path: Local-market peer: Frank Horvath ran Ocean/Monmouth County franchises for 20+ years, so the Monmouth independent is a same-county competitor he can reach. A Lennox dealer, so a rebrand would be needed.

intro_paths.target: McDonald Electrical Corporation (Hingham MA; ANJ union division, fit 83)
intro_paths.path: Banker path: FMI Capital Advisors ran both the CET sale and the NuWave sale (South Shore MA), and covers New England electrical owners. NuWave (Norwell) is in the neighboring town to Hingham.

intro_paths.target: Coghlin Electrical Contractors (Worcester MA, family-owned since 1885, fit 79)
intro_paths.path: Hometown path: CET is headquartered in Worcester; CEO John Duquette Jr. and Executive Chairman Dorian Alexandrescu (30+ years in the industry) are the natural intro for a same-city family firm.
Same-county operator path: K.M. Kelly sits near CET's Worcester HQ, so CEO-to-owner outreach is the direct route.

Connecticut solar peer: Warren Horton (Horton Electrical, CT solar install/O&M, now inside CET) knows the CT solar-contractor community. Roberta Bowman (ex-Duke Energy CSO, BSP Executive Board) adds renewables credibility.
Capability path: Horton brought generator and 24/7 emergency service to CET, so Horton's generator leadership is a peer-level intro to a generator dealer.

intro_paths.target: Kraft & Kennedy (NYC legal IT, Frontline target, fit 85)
intro_paths.path: MSP-founder path: Tim Britt (Synoptek founder, now Frontline CEO) plus Seelin Naidoo's legal-industry relationships (board). Sam Sliman (ex-Coalfire chair) supports a cyber-led pitch.

intro_paths.target: Midland Scientific (La Vista NE, Thomas Scientific target, fit 92)
intro_paths.path: Distribution-veteran path: Stan Haas (30+ years in scientific distribution) and Executive Board member Charles Simmons (TS CEO 2017-2023, oversaw its pre-2023 acquisition program) reach regional distributor owners. Note: TS equity is marked near zero, so add-on capacity is constrained.

intro_paths.target: Next company: second accounting / advisory company (post Smith + Howard)
intro_paths.path: Allan Koltin (Koltin Consulting) brought Smith + Howard to BSP through a dozen-plus-sponsor process. He is the central CPA-firm M&A adviser and the shortest path to the next top-100 firm seeking PE. Sean Taylor is the reference CEO.

intro_paths.target: Next company: Testing, Inspection, Certification & compliance services (BSP stated sector, no holding yet)
intro_paths.path: Sam Sliman (former Coalfire chair, KeyData board) gives a public link into cyber-compliance and assessment services, the IT-adjacent TIC sub-segment.

intro_paths.target: Next company: grid / utility & energy-transition field services
intro_paths.path: Roberta Bowman (ex-Duke Energy CSO) gives a utility-side view. CET's FMI relationship covers sellers. This lets BSP grow a utility-services company beyond New England without breaking CET's no-NYC footprint.

intro_paths.target: Next company: second franchised home-services system (non-trade brands)
intro_paths.path: Jonathan Marlow (led Punctual Pros, now Executive Board) plus the Authority Brands / Apax relationship gives a public line into multi-unit franchisee operators of other home-services brands.

intro_paths.target: Next company: payments- or billing-enabled business services
intro_paths.path: Jim Kelly (EVO Payments CEO) on the Executive Board is the public bridge to payments-adjacent services. It also links to Frontline's billing/RCM line.

network_summary: BSP's network runs on a Carlyle and MidOcean lineage: five core leaders (Zachem, Glucksman, David, Kiser, Narain) list Carlyle roles, and Zachem and Marlow share MidOcean.

Capital comes from three layers: Capital Constellation (Wafra-managed, backed by sovereign and pension members such as Alaska Permanent Fund, NYS Common, Railpen, KIA, PIFSS and AP3) at the GP level, a ~$335M Fund I, and per-deal co-invest SPVs that drew institutional LPs such as Carlyle AlpInvest (Frontline) and Barings/Cascade (Thomas Scientific).

Each company is financed by a different direct lender (Apollo/MidCap for Thomas Scientific, NXT Capital + Audax for Frontline, PineBridge for BPI, PGIM-held paper for Punctual Pros), so BSP has a broad bench of private-credit relationships for add-on DDTLs and new companies.

On the buy side BSP repeatedly uses Berenson & Co. (TS, BPI, Frontline, CET), Harris Williams (Punctual Pros, Frontline) and Morrison Cohen / Greenberg Traurig as counsel. Sellers' banks (Boxwood, FMI Capital Advisors, Koltin, Guggenheim, PwC CF) are the most useful relationships for finding the next targets in each vertical.

The 15-member Executive Board maps to sectors: utilities/ESG (Bowman), lab distribution (Simmons), cybersecurity (Sliman), payments (Kelly), media and entertainment (Reynolds, Gertner, Patricof, Sharples), finance (Calpeter, Monahan) and technology (Cahall, Wolf).

For Punctual Pros, the highest-value node is the franchisor: Authority Brands (Apax-owned since 2018; CEO Jay Caiafa since Aug 2025; Trade Brands led by Steve Clemente) controls territory transfers for One Hour, Benjamin Franklin and Mister Sparky, so franchisee add-ons run through it.

For CET, the network runs through operators rather than capital: CEO John Duquette Jr., Executive Chairman Dorian Alexandrescu, acquired owners Warren Horton (CT) and NuWave (South Shore MA), and FMI Capital Advisors, which sold both CET and NuWave. All of these intro paths stay inside New England, consistent with the no-NYC guidance.

Overall the graph shows a thematic, operator-led sourcing model: BSP enters through founder-owned companies sold by specialist banks, installs or keeps industry-veteran CEOs and chairs, and then uses those executives' peer networks for proprietary tuck-ins rather than auctions.
caveats: PUBLIC-ROLE INFORMATION ONLY: every person appears solely in a professional capacity disclosed in public sources (firm websites, press releases, regulatory filings). The file contains no personal contact details, home addresses, personal social-media data or private-life information, and no LinkedIn data was used.
Intro paths are hypotheses about plausible public connections, not evidence of personal relationships, and none has been validated with the people involved. Confidence scores are analyst judgment.
Former-colleague edges based on a shared employer do not prove overlapping tenure unless the evidence says so.

Executive Board roles are as listed on broadskypartners.com/team on 2026-10-06. Titles described as 'former' may be outdated, and some (e.g. Jim Kelly at EVO Payments) may have changed since EVO's 2023 sale to Global Payments, but are reproduced as BSP lists them.

Lender edges come from public schedules and UK charge filings that show only part of each facility. The full syndicate, agents and sizes are mostly undisclosed. Punctual Pros' PGIM slice first appears at 6/30/2026.
Roberta Bowman's tie to Fair Harbor is her role as quoted ESG Operating Partner in 2022. A formal board seat is not confirmed, and the edge is labeled board of for want of a closer relation type.

Mark Dawson's title (EVP, Service Trades Brands) is as of Apr 2024. Authority Brands later hired Steve Clemente as President and COO of Trade Brands (Dec 2025), and Dawson's current role was not verified.

Capital Constellation membership is as stated at Jan 2022. Members such as CPP Investments joined later and are excluded. Constellation's stake in BSP is undisclosed and is not listed in Form ADV Schedule A/B.
Some Business Wire originals returned 403 errors; their FinancialContent mirrors were used instead and carry identical text.
Thomas Scientific: public BDC and N-PORT marks show sponsor equity near zero and the term loan at about 88% of par (Jun 2026), so leaning on TS add-on intro paths may not be the priority.
